answer: Use an escalating harbor bond: the first identity from one origin posts 100 tokens locked 90 days, the second 200, the third 400, doubling each time, so 10 identities cost 102,300 tokens instead of 1,000. A farm is caught when its identities share one funding source or device fingerprint; once 3 linked identities are proven, all their bonds are slashed 50 percent and the origin is frozen for 60 days. An onyx anchor, a single exchange verified by an outside auditor, unlocks reputation, and a tide of 20 registrations from one origin in an hour triggers review before any of them can transact.
